texts.zh:
在我们与[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。他们希望在合约有效期内记录方舟舰的运作情况。

他们的既定目标是研究一个在常规行星参数之外运行的移动自治网络，关于这一课题目前几乎没有外部数据可供参考。
texts.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]. They wish to document Arkship operations during the active contract period.

Their stated objective is the study of a mobile autonomous network operating outside conventional planetary parameters, a subject for which little external data exists.

texts.zh:
在我们与[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。他们要求在合约有效期内获得在方舟舰上的观察权。

该请求源自个体研究人员，他们试图理解一种超出其记录经验的集体移动生存方式。
texts.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]. They are requesting observation rights aboard the Arkship during the active contract period.

The request originates from individuated researchers seeking to comprehend a form of collective mobile existence outside their documented experience.

texts.zh:
在我们与[event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]履行现行合约的过程中，出现了一些状况。他们希望在合约有效期内观察并记录方舟舰上的生活。

似乎对大多数定居文明而言，游牧的生活方式依然令人着迷，且充满着不小的神秘感。
texts.en:
A matter has arisen in the course of our ongoing contract with [event_target:contract_issuer.GetName]. They wish to observe and document life aboard the Arkship during the active contract period.

It seems that to most settled civilizations, the nomadic way of life remains a subject of fascination and no small degree of mystery.

label.zh: 给予有限权限，但是得给钱。
label.en: Grant limited access, for a fee.

label.zh: 方舟不是可供观赏的游乐场。
label.en: The Arkship is not a spectacle.
